original_input: What is the difference between Je voulais partir and J'ai voulu partir?
original_context: Learning note: Je voulais partir describes a past wish or intention. J'ai voulu partir can present wanting as a bounded event in context; avoid assuming a single English translation without context. Synthetic practice discussion.
discussion_summary: Learning note: Je voulais partir describes a past wish or intention. J'ai voulu partir can present wanting as a bounded event in context; avoid assuming a single English translation without context. Synthetic practice discussion.

analysis.explanation: Contrast the ongoing past wish in Je voulais with the bounded reading of J'ai voulu, with meaning depending on context.
